jobs.description:
Essential Job Functions

Strategic Marketing & Planning:

 Design, implement, maintain, and expand the overall marketing plan and develop new marketing strategies that support long-range goals and revenue objectives. Analyze market data, guest demographics, and competitive landscape to identify key local and regional populations with propensity for gaming and entertainment. Develop marketing plans for amenities, special projects, events, and new business initiatives. Participate in formulating and administering company policies and long-range goals and objectives. Submit recommendations for marketing programs, promotions, and group sales initiatives.

Group Sales & Tour Development

 Develop and manage the group sales program, including charter bus and tour operator partnerships. Identify, develop, and maintain business relationships with tour operators, travel coordinators, and group organizers. Develop, monitor, and optimize all tour and bus group business to the property. Establish and oversee commission and incentive programs for groups and partners. Serve as primary liaison with corporate and group partners regarding all group needs, logistics, and on-property activities. Ensure all group procedures and service standards are followed consistently. Coordinate hotel rooms, event tickets, and related amenities for groups or individuals as requested by the General Manager.

Promotions, Advertising & Communications

 Work with advertising agencies and internal teams to develop and execute marketing campaigns, promotions, and advertising across traditional and digital channels. Plan, implement, and oversee guest-facing promotions including drawings, tournaments, special events, and other casino promotions. Analyze reports and performance data related to promotions, campaigns, and marketing ROI; adjust strategies accordingly. Oversee coordination of press conferences, media relations, and public relations activities on property. Coordinate related donations and community engagement activities in support of brand and goodwill.

Leadership & Team Management

 Provide overall management and supervision of all marketing operations and department staff. Select, train, evaluate, schedule, promote, coach, discipline, and terminate associates as needed to maintain appropriate staffing levels. Formulate and deliver training programs that support marketing excellence and operational standards. Foster an atmosphere that encourages associates to share ideas, discuss concerns, and resolve conflicts constructively. Ensure a maximum level of guest service and satisfaction is achieved and maintained throughout the property. Remain proficient in relevant computer systems, reporting tools, and spreadsheet applications to maximize data driven

decision making.

 Assist with and participate in marketing functions and special projects as required.

Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, Hospitality, or a related field; or equivalent combination

of education and experience.

 Minimum of five (5) years of progressive marketing and advertising experience, preferably in the casino,

hospitality, or entertainment industry.

 Demonstrated knowledge of group sales, convention sales, and tour/travel partner programs. Strong understanding of the Rhode Island and New England regional market, including local demographics and

competitive landscape.

 Proven ability to develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns across traditional, digital, and experiential

channels.

 Excellent guest service orientation, interpersonal skills, and organizational abilities. Proficiency with personal computers, Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), and marketing/CRM

systems.

 Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret reports, market data, and performance metrics. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, and

governmental regulations.

 Ability to write clear reports, business correspondence, and procedural manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, customers, and the

general public.

 Must be able to obtain and maintain a Rhode Island Department of Business Regulation Gaming License.

License Requirements

Rhode Island Department of Business Regulation Gaming License (must be obtained and maintained as a condition of

employment).

Physical & Mental Requirements

 Constant: planning, directing others, following directions, reading, writing, using math, working at varying tempos,

making decisions, concentrating, remembering, and attending to and observing details.

 Frequent: sitting, standing, walking, using eye/hand coordination, handling, and wrist motion. Ability to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as required by business needs.

Working Conditions

Primarily indoors in a climate-controlled environment; occasional outdoor activities. Exposure to noise, smoke, and odors

typical of a casino environment. Work involves both independent responsibilities and collaboration with others across

departments.

Target Salary Range: ($120,000.00 - $140,000.00)

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The Business Marketing Group connects businesses with their customers on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger to help them grow their businesses through solutions like pages, advertising, messaging, and more. We succeed when we help our customers grow their business leveraging our solutions. The Global Marketing Operations team runs campaign execution for business marketing, launching hundreds of campaigns a year across an expanding set of digital marketing channels.We are seeking a Marketing Operations Manager who executes campaigns AI-first, pairing deep expertise in marketing execution platforms with the AI skills to automate that work. This role is about owning operational quality by setting executional standards that can be built at agent scale. The ideal candidate is a digital marketing expert who has already replaced meaningful parts of their own workflow with AI and can show what it produced.





Marketing Operations Manager Responsibilities:


Own campaign execution and execution quality for an assigned business area, from brief through launch, across lifecycle, email, in-product messaging, web, and Meta ads
Use AI as the primary tool for execution work, including build specification, copy and asset variants, audience logic, and QA
Build, configure, and test AI agents that execute campaign workflows, and own the automation roadmap for the area, reporting results in turnaround time, cost, and error rate
Pilot new delivery capabilities, then codify what correct execution looks like and the eval rubrics that hold agents to it
Advise partners at the brief stage on what is executable and at what cost, and translate execution learnings into platform requirements
Raise the AI capability of the team through documentation, enablement, and coaching
Find new ways to continually streamline execution processes, including working with XFNs (if needed) to automate handoff





Minimum Qualifications:


6+ years of experience in marketing operations, campaign management, or marketing automation
Hands-on build experience in at least two digital marketing channels among email, paid social, in-product messaging, web, and SEM or display, with expert-level depth in at least one execution or ads platform (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, HubSpot, Adobe)
Demonstrated use of AI to produce real marketing work output, with specific examples of what was automated and the measured effect on time, cost, quality, or volume
Hands-on experience building, configuring, and evaluating AI agents or LLM-based workflows, including prompt iteration and judgment on where output requires human review
Experience owning campaign execution at portfolio scale, including QA and trade-off decisions across competing requests
Experience scaling impact beyond own execution, through standards others adopted, requirements platform teams built, and enablement that raised team capability
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience in digital marketing





Preferred Qualifications:


Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
Experience supporting B2B marketing efforts or high-volume audience segments at global scale
Experience leading the transition of a workflow from manual execution to automated or agentic execution
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
Experience connecting AI tools to marketing systems through APIs, integrations, or agent tooling
SQL fluency or comparable data skills, sufficient to validate audiences and interrogate campaign performance independently
Comfort working in ambiguity, where the standard does not exist yet and part of the job is writing it
Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Cura Ayurvedic & Unani Limited · Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh · On-site · Full-time




WHY THIS SEAT EXISTS




Cura is a twenty six year old wellness manufacturer that sold through trade for most of its life and is now building direct-to-consumer properly, our own store, the marketplaces, and a growing content and PR footprint behind them.




Paid acquisition has never had an owner here. Nobody currently owns what a customer costs us, or what that customer is worth after the first order. This seat owns both, and builds the measurement that makes either number trustworthy.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN




Every rupee of paid media Cura spends. Meta, Google, YouTube, and marketplace advertising on Amazon and Flipkart, held as one view of acquisition cost rather than as separate platform reports.The creative testing pipeline. Not requesting ad creative and waiting. Deciding what hypothesis each piece of creative exists to test, briefing our design and video team against it, and judging what won and why.Lifecycle and retention. Email, CRM, and the journey from first order to repeat order. In supplements that is where the economics actually live, and it is currently nobody's job.The measurement framework. GA4, attribution, and one honest view of what paid is producing — including closing the tracking gaps rather than reporting around them.The monthly performance picture. One report to the CMO that someone outside marketing could read, with a recommendation on where the next rupee should go attached to it.


WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT




Not media buying alone. We are not looking for someone to execute a plan that someone else wrote. The strategy is part of the seat.Not organic search. Our SEO seat owns technical search, keyword architecture and answer-engine visibility.Not social content or community. Our social seat owns the calendar, the channels and the conversations. You own paid distribution, not the organic feed.Not store or catalogue operations. Our E-commerce Manager owns listings, inventory, pricing and fulfilment. Marketplace advertising sits with you; the listings underneath it sit with her, and the two of you agree the handover.Not creative production. We have a design and video team in-house. You brief them and you judge the output; you are not the one making it.


WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE BY DAY 90




A measurement baseline everyone trusts — tracking gaps closed, attribution agreed, and a single dashboard the CMO reads without needing it explained.A structured testing cadence running across creative and audience, with a written log rather than remembered results.A first honest read on acquisition cost by channel and by product, and a recommendation on where spend should move next.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR




Three things decide this hire.




1. You have owned a direct-to-consumer paid account end to end, not a slice of one. You set the account structure, you made the spend calls, and you were the person accountable for the number — not the person reporting into them.




2. You think in unit economics, not platform metrics. You know that the ROAS inside Ads Manager and the money in the bank are different numbers, and you work to the second one.




3. You can brief creative and judge it. Most performance marketers request creative and hope. The good ones decide what a creative is testing before it is made, and can say afterwards why one ad beat another.




Also useful:

• Four to seven years in performance marketing, with D2C or FMCG experience

• Hands-on across Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads; marketplace advertising a plus

• GA4 and attribution to a diagnostic standard, able to fix a tracking gap, not only report around it

• Email and CRM platform experience, on Klaviyo, WebEngage or similar

• Hindi and English both. A large share of our customers search, read and buy in Hindi

• Wellness, supplements or another regulated category is a plus, not a requirement




THE CATEGORY REALITY




Cura sells wellness products, and that is a regulated category in India. Ad copy, landing pages and creative all count as advertising in the regulatory sense, and there are claims we will not make at any price, no disease cure, no treatment promise, no time-bound result.




Some of the highest-performing angles in wellness are simply not available to us. When that happens the answer is to find a different angle, not a way around the rule. If that reads as a constraint you would want to work around, this is not the right seat. If it reads as an interesting problem, you will like it here.




HOW WE HIRE




A first conversation with the CMO, the accounts you have owned, what you actually decided on them, and compensation discussed openly before we ask anything further of you.A working session on a real Cura problem, with the numbers in front of us. A conversation, not a test.A paid work sample for final candidates only: a thirty-day paid plan for one Cura product, with the testing structure and the measurement you would put behind it. Paid at a flat fee agreed before you begin (Hence, you will be compensated for the same)A final conversation with the CMO and the Executive Director.


Four stages, usually inside three weeks. We tell you where you stand after each one.




HOW TO APPLY




Send your CV to hr@curaayurved.com with a short note naming one paid account you owned, roughly what it spent, and one decision you made on it that you would still defend today.


No cover letter. We would rather read the one decision.

jobs.description:
Our Purpose



Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.



Title and Summary



Senior Analyst, Marketing

Who is Mastercard?
We are the global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, a technology innovation lab, and the home of Priceless®. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives.  We believe as our company grows, so should you. We believe in connecting everyone to endless, priceless possibilities.
 
•	Integrated Campaigns & Thought Leadership: Collaborate with product, sales, regional marketing, and research teams to identify market insights and thought leadership opportunities, translating them into compelling content and integrated B2B marketing campaigns that engage target audiences across digital, social, web, and sales enablement channels.
•	Content Development & Asset Creation: Develop marketing assets that support Digital Payments (including Click to Pay, Tokenization, and Passkeys). Create customer videos, playbooks, research, B2B and B2C toolkits to drive market education and adoption. 
•	Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with stakeholders across product, marketing operations, media, digital, communications, legal, and agency partners to ensure seamless execution of marketing initiatives and compliance with brand and business requirements. 
•	Performance Measurement & Optimization: Monitor, analyze, and report on campaign performance, leveraging data, insights, and AI-enabled tools to optimize marketing effectiveness and inform future strategies.

All About You – Key Qualifications & Skills
•	Experience in B2B marketing, with a focus on campaign management or content strategy.
•	Excellent writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts into compelling content and customer value propositions for business audiences.
•	Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
•	Experience working effectively in highly cross-functional, global organizations.
•	Familiarity using AI-enabled tools to improve content creation, research, campaign execution, and marketing efficiency.

Beneficial 
•	Background in payment technologies and products, experience in a B2B sales organization, and familiarity with marketing, analytics, and social media platforms that support digital engagement and demand generation.

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Demand Generation - Paid Social
jobs.description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.


When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.


 


Senior Analyst, Demand Generation - Paid Social & Programatic





Why We Have This Role
Qualtrics is an Experience Management company, and enterprise decisions about experience programs are not made by one person. They are made by a committee — a CX or HR leader who owns the outcome, an insights team that vets the method, an IT and procurement group that stress-tests the platform, and a finance leader who wants to see the return. Reaching that committee takes media deliberately built for every stage of the journey, not a single campaign pointed at a single job title.


We run that media across two disciplines that have to work as one system: paid social, where we earn attention inside the feeds our buyers already live in, and programmatic, where we reach them everywhere else and control reach, frequency, and inventory quality at scale. A buyer does not experience these as separate channels, so we do not staff them as separate silos. Everyone on this team works across both.


This role makes that system run. You will build, launch, and optimize campaigns across paid social and programmatic globally — owning execution end to end, from brief to live to optimized to reported. You will work closely with the Lead Paid Media Manager, who sets the strategy you are executing, and you are expected to help shape it: you are closest to the platforms and the data, and the plan should reflect what you are seeing.


How You’ll Find Success

Full-Funnel & Dual-Channel Focus: You thrive on managing campaigns across both paid social and programmatic as one connected system rather than separate silos.
Flawless Execution Discipline: You take pride in meticulous campaign setup—from tracking, naming, and conversion configuration to rigorous pre-launch QA.
Evidence-Based Optimization: You let data guide your decisions, optimizing daily across pacing, bids, audience performance, and budget allocations.
Strategic Initiative: You bring actionable recommendations and recommendations on spend shifts to performance reviews rather than just presenting reports.
Proactive Problem Solving: You troubleshoot delivery, pacing, tracking, and match-rate issues independently, escalating with a diagnosis rather than just a symptom.

How You’ll Grow

Protected Strategy Time: 20% of your time is dedicated and protected for strategy, analysis, and planning contribution to support your professional growth.
Incremental Strategy Ownership: Take full ownership of a defined slice of the program (a channel, region, product line, or funnel stage) that expands as you demonstrate judgment.
Lead Strategic Initiatives: Drive one major strategic project per quarter beyond day-to-day execution, such as channel evaluations, audience restructures, or new platform tests.
Mentorship Toward Senior Roles: Work directly with the Lead Paid Media Manager, who is accountable for developing your strategic judgment and handing over ownership as you prepare for senior and lead-level roles.

Things You’ll Do

Drive Full-Funnel Growth: Build, launch, and optimize global campaigns directly in-platform across paid social (LinkedIn, Meta, X, Reddit, emerging platforms) and programmatic (DV360, The Trade Desk, StackAdapt, CTV/OLV, display, native, audio) from brief to reporting.
Maximize Target Account Coverage: Onboard and manage account-based audiences (6sense, Demandbase, Terminus) while maintaining clean suppression and exclusion architectures to eliminate wasted spend on active opportunities, competitors, or non-serviceable accounts.
Optimize Budget & Pacing: Daily manage pacing and in-flight budget allocations within guardrails for a defined portion of the global media budget, forecasting spend accurately and recommending reallocations based on marginal return.
Lead Campaign Testing & Strategy: Design, execute, and report on test plans for assigned programs, presenting performance reviews that conclude with clear, data-driven recommendations on what to change.
Cross-Functional Campaign Delivery: Partner with demand generation, marketing operations, sales development, and creative teams to ensure clear brief requirements, smooth lead flow, and privacy compliance (GDPR/CCPA).

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

Hands-On Dual-Channel Experience: 4–6 years of hands-on paid media experience (majority in B2B), with personal experience building and optimizing campaigns in both paid social and programmatic platforms.
Execution & Technical Rigor: Practical experience with campaign architecture, tracking, conversion configuration, and UTM discipline, alongside working knowledge of CRMs (Salesforce/Marketo), web analytics, and BI tools.
Full-Funnel Strategy Execution: Demonstrated understanding of top-, mid-, and bottom-of-funnel audience strategies, account-based advertising platforms, and intent data in long enterprise sales cycles.
Data-Driven Decision Making & Communication: Proven ability to run campaign

Meta, Google, YouTube, and marketplace advertising on Amazon and Flipkart, held as one view of acquisition cost rather than as separate platform reports.The creative testing pipeline. Not requesting ad creative and waiting. Deciding what hypothesis each piece of creative exists to test, briefing our design and video team against it, and judging what won and why.Lifecycle and retention. Email, CRM, and the journey from first order to repeat order. In supplements that is where the economics actually live, and it is currently nobody's job.The measurement framework. GA4, attribution, and one honest view of what paid is producing — including closing the tracking gaps rather than reporting around them.The monthly performance picture. One report to the CMO that someone outside marketing could read, with a recommendation on where the next rupee should go attached to it.


WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT




Not media buying alone. We are not looking for someone to execute a plan that someone else wrote. The strategy is part of the seat.Not organic search. Our SEO seat owns technical search, keyword architecture and answer-engine visibility.Not social content or community. Our social seat owns the calendar, the channels and the conversations. You own paid distribution, not the organic feed.Not store or catalogue operations. Our E-commerce Manager owns listings, inventory, pricing and fulfilment. Marketplace advertising sits with you; the listings underneath it sit with her, and the two of you agree the handover.Not creative production. We have a design and video team in-house. You brief them and you judge the output; you are not the one making it.


WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE BY DAY 90




A measurement baseline everyone trusts — tracking gaps closed, attribution agreed, and a single dashboard the CMO reads without needing it explained.A structured testing cadence running across creative and audience, with a written log rather than remembered results.A first honest read on acquisition cost by channel and by product, and a recommendation on where spend should move next.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR




Three things decide this hire.




1. You have owned a direct-to-consumer paid account end to end, not a slice of one. You set the account structure, you made the spend calls, and you were the person accountable for the number — not the person reporting into them.




2. You think in unit economics, not platform metrics. You know that the ROAS inside Ads Manager and the money in the bank are different numbers, and you work to the second one.




3. You can brief creative and judge it. Most performance marketers request creative and hope. The good ones decide what a creative is testing before it is made, and can say afterwards why one ad beat another.




Also useful:

• Four to seven years in performance marketing, with D2C or FMCG experience

• Hands-on across Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads; marketplace advertising a plus

• GA4 and attribution to a diagnostic standard, able to fix a tracking gap, not only report around it

• Email and CRM platform experience, on Klaviyo, WebEngage or similar

• Hindi and English both. A large share of our customers search, read and buy in Hindi

• Wellness, supplements or another regulated category is a plus, not a requirement




THE CATEGORY REALITY




Cura sells wellness products, and that is a regulated category in India. Ad copy, landing pages and creative all count as advertising in the regulatory sense, and there are claims we will not make at any price, no disease cure, no treatment promise, no time-bound result.




Some of the highest-performing angles in wellness are simply not available to us. When that happens the answer is to find a different angle, not a way around the rule. If that reads as a constraint you would want to work around, this is not the right seat. If it reads as an interesting problem, you will like it here.




HOW WE HIRE




A first conversation with the CMO, the accounts you have owned, what you actually decided on them, and compensation discussed openly before we ask anything further of you.A working session on a real Cura problem, with the numbers in front of us. A conversation, not a test.A paid work sample for final candidates only: a thirty-day paid plan for one Cura product, with the testing structure and the measurement you would put behind it. Paid at a flat fee agreed before you begin (Hence, you will be compensated for the same)A final conversation with the CMO and the Executive Director.


Four stages, usually inside three weeks. We tell you where you stand after each one.




HOW TO APPLY




Send your CV to hr@curaayurved.com with a short note naming one paid account you owned, roughly what it spent, and one decision you made on it that you would still defend today.


No cover letter. We would rather read the one decision.

Most performance marketers request creative and hope
Four to seven years in performance marketing, with D2C or FMCG experience
GA4 and attribution to a diagnostic standard, able to fix a tracking gap, not only report around it
Email and CRM platform experience, on Klaviyo, WebEngage or similar
Hindi and English both
A large share of our customers search, read

new_jobs.title: Executive Director, Marketing Strategy
new_jobs.description:
Executive Director, Marketing Strategy & Partnerships; Camgian is seeking a strategic marketing and partnerships executive to shape how the market understands Camgian and Reactor®, and to build the partner ecosystem that carries both into new customers and missions. You will be responsible for enterprise growth strategies, market identification, ecosystem development, product commercialization research and enablement, developing and managing strategic partnerships, and customer engagement activities, while representing Camgian’s brand, culture, mission, and values to customers, partners, and industry. Reporting to the Executive Vice President of Growth & Product Marketing, you will expand the profile, reach, and revenue impact of Camgian and its products.

Position Summary

The Executive Director, Marketing Strategy & Partnerships is a senior growth leader responsible for defining and executing the marketing and ecosystem strategy that drives pipeline, revenue, and market position for Camgian’s AI-enabled Decision Logic products, led by Reactor®. The role spans corporate marketing, brand and category positioning, demand generation, thought leadership, and strategic partnerships across defense, government, and commercial markets.

This executive will lead market strategy for Reactor’s core mission areas, including integrated air and missile defense, counter-UAS, and multi-domain command and control, and will build partnerships with prime contractors, systems integrators, sensor and effector providers, and technology companies that position Reactor as the decision layer inside larger programs and architectures.

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to Growth leadership, work in lockstep with capture, business development, and product management, and turn market insight into positioning, campaigns, and partnerships that measurably accelerate growth.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute a comprehensive corporate marketing strategy that strengthens Camgian's market position.Lead positioning for Reactor and the Decision Logic category, establishing Camgian as a recognized leader in AI-enabled decision support and kill chain automation.Build and run the executive thought leadership program, including speaking engagements, bylined articles, white papers, podcasts, and media opportunities.Oversee public relations, strategic communications, analyst and influencer relations, and reputation management.Direct the website, digital presence, and content strategy so they reflect Camgian’s current capabilities and priorities.Demand Generation & Growth Enablement

Plan and execute integrated campaigns (digital, events, content, and direct engagement) that generate qualified pipeline in priority markets.Align marketing programs with capture and business development plans to shape requirements and accelerate opportunity creation.Develop capture and sales enablement, including customer profiles, competitive positioning, battle cards, demo narratives, and proposal-ready content.Own trade show and event strategy, from selection and messaging through booth presence and post-event follow-through.Capture customer feedback and win/loss insights and feed them back into positioning, product, and growth plans.Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Development

Define the partnership strategy and target partner portfolio across prime contractors, systems integrators, sensor and effector OEMs, technology and platform providers, academic and research institutions, and industry associations.Identify, negotiate, and manage teaming agreements, strategic alliances, channel arrangements, and co-marketing relationships.Build joint go-to-market plans with partners, including shared messaging, demonstrations, and pursuits.Work with Capture and Contracts to structure teaming arrangements that position Reactor on priority pursuits.Track partner performance and partner-sourced pipeline; invest in the relationships that produce results and retire those that do not.Industry Leadership & Corporate Representation

Represent Camgian at conferences, trade shows, industry forums, and executive engagements as a senior ambassador for its mission, culture, and strategic vision.Build relationships with customers, government leaders, industry influencers, investors, and media.Expand Camgian’s presence in industry associations, working groups, and innovation networks.Team Leadership & Operational Excellence

Lead, develop, and scale the marketing and partnerships team, including agencies and contractors.Own the marketing and partnerships budget and allocate resources to the highest-return programs.Establish KPIs, dashboards, and reporting for marketing, brand, and partnership performance; review results with Growth leadership quarterly and adjust plans accordingly.Ensure external content and partner activities comply with contractual, export control (ITAR/EAR), and public-release requirements.Desired Skills

Strategic mindset with a strong sense of brand, product, and market positioning.Ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear, compelling value for operators, acquisition leaders, and executives.Skilled relationship builder and negotiator with big-picture,
